description: Displayed near the perimeter and visible from the highway; wears 585. Unusually displayed without wingtip tanks.
Displayed on base. A 2013 on-site photograph read the number as 6022; Wikipedia's UH-1 display list gives 6002.
Civil-registered Aero Commander 681 standing on base with engines and propellers removed; how it came to be at an army camp is unexplained. Noted 2013.
